body: The terminal now fills the card, and there's only a thin margin above and below it. The picture renderer used to stop growing the text at 1.4 times. That still left a single prompt floating in an empty card, so the limit is now 1.8 (hub afbae84). Long pictures never reach the limit, so they don't change. The picture is redrawn in blog commit 012ac3f3, and the after picture is in this thread.
